🔥 टीवी स्क्रीन पर फिर से हंगामा मचाने आ रही हैं बॉलीवुड क्वीन शिल्पा शेट्टी!

📺 शिल्पा शेट्टी जल्द ही एक नया धमाकेदार रिलेशनशिप रियलिटी शो Pyaar Ka Pressure Cooker होस्ट करने जा रही हैं।
✨ यह शो चैनल Colors और JioHotstar पर दिखाया जाएगा और Bigg Boss का टाइम स्लॉट संभालेगा।

इस शो में कपल्स और उनके पेरेंट्स एक छत के नीचे आकर सिचुएशनशिप और कमिटमेंट इश्यूज पर सीधी बात करेंगे। शो में पेरेंट्स के लिए 'Jodo Ya Todo' और 'Clarity Ki Seeti' जैसे स्पेशल सेगमेंट्स बनाए गए हैं।

शिल्पा ने कहा कि आज के दौर में रिलेशनशिप्स की क्लैरिटी खो गई है और यह शो कपल्स के साथ पेरेंट्स के लिए भी रिलेटेबल होगा।

Maa Hai Na के बाद इस साल शिल्पा का यह दूसरा होस्टिंग असाइनमेंट है, इससे पहले वो Super Dancer और Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa भी जज कर चुकी हैं।

💭 क्या आप Bigg Boss की जगह आने वाले इस नए शो Pyaar Ka Pressure Cooker के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए!

ctx.text:
Shilpa Shetty will host Pyaar Ka Pressure Cooker, a relationship reality show featuring couples and their parents, on Colors and JioHotstar.
Shilpa Shetty is set to return as a host with a new reality show titled Pyaar Ka Pressure Cooker. The relationship-based reality series will air on Colors and stream on JioHotstar. The show will bring couples under one roof as they confront relationship issues, discuss their future together and seek clarity on their equations.
The format will explore subjects such as situationships, commitment issues and uncertainty about taking relationships forward. It will also involve the parents of the participating couples, who will share their perspectives through segments titled 'Jodo Ya Todo' and 'Clarity Ki Seeti'. The show is expected to take over the time slot currently occupied by Bigg Boss.
Speaking about the concept and her association with the show, Shilpa said, “Relationships today come with a whole new vocabulary, from situationships and breadcrumbing to benching, and somewhere along the way, clarity got lost.”
She further explained what interested her about the format, adding, “What excites me about 'Pyaar Ka Pressure Cooker' is its fresh take on the reality format... It's relatable for couples, and just as much for the parents watching.”
A post shared by Shilpa Shetty Kundra (@theshilpashetty)
Pyaar Ka Pressure Cooker marks Shilpa's second hosting assignment this year after Maa Hai Na. The actor has also been associated with several television reality shows as a judge, including Super Dancer and Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa.
With its focus on relationship dynamics and family involvement, the upcoming show will bring couples and their parents into conversations about commitment, compatibility and the decisions that shape their relationships. Further details about its premiere date and participating couples are awaited.
